summary.text: Heather Scribner is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 118, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Colleen Maxwell (Democratic).
She won the June 23, 2026 Republican primary with 40.0% of the vote, ahead of Charles Potter and Chanda King.
